map.Input: 目标总重量 60 kg、杠铃杆重 20 kg。\n每侧需配重 =:
Input: target total 60 kg, barbell bar 20 kg. 
 Weight per side = (60 − 20) ÷ 2 = 20 kg. 
 If plate sizes include a 20 kg single, then 1 plate per side, 2 plates total, 40 kg plates + 20 kg bar = 60 kg, error 0. 
 Conclusion: target 60 kg is exactly met with a 20 kg bar + 20 kg per side, symmetric with no error.

map.为什么必须两侧对称配重？: Why must plates be symmetric on both sides?
map.左右不对称会使杠铃重心偏移，卧推/深蹲时一侧肌肉代偿、脊柱受力不均，长期易伤肩腰: Asymmetry shifts the barbell's center of gravity; in bench press/squat one side's muscles compensate and the spine bears uneven force, easily injuring shoulders and lower back over time. This tool forces equal sides and computes error, prompting 'precise loading success' before it is safe to load.
map.没有刚好 20 kg 片怎么办？: What if there is no exact 20 kg plate?
map.可用组合凑出 20 kg（如 10+5+2.5+2.5）。本工具按现有片规格做最: Combine to make 20 kg (e.g. 10+5+2.5+2.5). This tool does the closest split by existing plate sizes and marks the error; if error is too large, actively lower to a weight that can be made exactly—do not 'eyeball' it.
